messages.text: Hi, I sent back the wireless mouse. Could I get a refund?

messages.name: assess_refund
messages.content: {"ok": true, "outcome": "eligible", "policy_citations": ["refund-policy/v2/amount"], "amount_minor": 6990, "currency": "BRL", "order": {"order_id": "d41-o1", "status": "delivered", "delivered_at": "2026-10-06T16:00:00+00:00", "refund_deadline": "2026-11-05T16:00:00+00:00", "payment_records": 1, "one_valid_payment": true}, "units": [{"unit_id": "d41-o1-u1", "product": "Wireless mouse", "paid_minor": 6990, "received_back": true, "refunded": false, "receipt_number": null, "earlier_on_time_proposal": false}], "next_step": "This assessment does not create or change a proposal. messages.text: Your refund proposal for the wireless mouse is BRL 69.90. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; typing “yes” here won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

messages.text: The BRL 69.90 refund has been paid to the order’s original payment. Receipt: **R-00000001**.

messages.text: Does the money go back to my card or to store credit?

It was recorded against the order’s original payment, not as store credit. In this demonstration, the receipt records the refund in the shop’s test ledger; it isn’t a bank transfer, and the shop can’t say when it will appear on your card. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/payout)
